The [[Kurzick Gatekeeper]]s allow members of the [[alliance]] who own the [[outpost]] or [[town]] to enter an exclusive area.

==Locations==
*[[Echovald Forest]]
**{{NPC location|Altrumm Ruins|outpost}}
**{{NPC location|Amatz Basin|outpost}}
**{{NPC location|Brauer Academy}}
**{{NPC location|Durheim Archives}}
**{{NPC location|House zu Heltzer}}
**{{NPC location|Lutgardis Conservatory}}
**{{NPC location|Saint Anjeka's Shrine}}
**{{NPC location|Tanglewood Copse}}
**{{NPC location|Vasburg Armory}}

==Dialogue==
If your alliance does not own the outpost or town:
:''"The <alliance that owns the outpost or town> controls this area."''

If your alliance does own the outpost or town:
:''"This area belongs to your alliance, the <alliance name>."''
:{{yes|ingame}} '''We have business in the exclusive area.'''
::''"When you are ready to travel, I will take you to the exclusive area."''
::{{yes|ingame}} '''I am ready.'''
::{{no|ingame}} '''I am not ready.'''

When trying to leave the exclusive area:
:''"I will let you pass. Just tell me when you're ready."''
:{{yes|ingame}} '''Let's go!'''
:{{no|ingame}} '''Maybe another time.'''

==Notes==
*The Gatekeeper on the outside of the exclusive area is always a male, while the gatekeeper on the inside is always a female.
